translation.title: Insect Bites and Itching Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of sprains, bruises, muscle pain, joint pain, pain from fractures, low back pain, stiff shoulders, neuralgia, and rheumatic pain, and for itchy skin, insect bites and chilblains.
translation.usage: Apply 1 to several patches a day to the affected area as appropriate.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine; the eyes or the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas; sensitive skin. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced an allergic reaction (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer) from medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; people with a circulatory disorder or diabetes; children aged 12 years or under; women who are pregnant or may be pregnant; breastfeeding women. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only; it must not be swallowed. Take care to keep it out of the eyes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water. Hands with the medicine on them can irritate the eyes and other mucous membranes, so wash the medicine off your hands thoroughly. Do not cover or wrap the application site, and do not expose it to external heat or hot water. If water touches the area where the medicine was applied, you may feel strong irritation. People with delicate skin must not use it continuously on the same area. Keep it away from items that may be dissolved by alcohol and the like, such as spectacle frames and synthetic fibres. If a large amount is absorbed through the skin, symptoms of poisoning may occur, so avoid using it on a large area for a long period. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness; swelling; itching; pain. Keep out of reach of children. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light.
